---
title: "After the session"
---

The session stops before two parts of the exercise: the causal graph of the claim, which Task 2 of the [browser lab](../../lab.qmd#task-4-estimand-and-dag) lets you finish, and the preregistration of one analysis before it runs, which is Task 5 of the lab. Both also run in the workspace of the case study, a folder that you [download as a zip file]({{< var cases.europeanisation.workspace-zip >}}) and open in your IDE.

The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) covers what the session could only mention, in modules that each stand on their own:

- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) – the ideas behind the curve and the arguments made against it.
- [Scale construction](../../companion/measurement.qmd) – the item battery of the Eurobarometer question, and what the choice of items does to the curve.
- [Panel data](../../companion/panel-data.qmd) – the estimators of the menu and the problem of few clusters.
- [Meta-analysis](../../companion/meta-analysis.qmd) – the five analysts on one scale.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) – the public record of the claim on the OSF.
- [Data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) – the route to the Eurobarometer files at GESIS.
